name: zigzag-go-frontend
//: frontend/src is zigzag's src/frontend/src, copied byte-identical — including its extensionless relative imports (the builder resolves .js for them). There is no "type": "module" here: nothing gains from it. dist/ is a BUILD OUTPUT, what //go:embed all:dist compiles into the binary, written by cmd/frontendbuild (the Go builder that replaced webpack, run through build.mjs) together with the source pack, so the frontend build runs before `go build` — the Taskfile enforces that. Dependencies are zigzag's verbatim, plus @wailsio/runtime for the bridge; playwright is omitted with its UI smoke harness.
